reproduction_assumptions: This configuration is not paper-equivalent because it adds one fixed-bin HotSpot anchor before optimization.
It must not be used to claim final performance improvement until gradient-direction and selection-regret tests pass.
The fixed-bin anchor and the final selected-layout HotSpot must share module geometry, power, stack, cooling, grid, and input granularity.
